tasks.title: Keep planning and statistics native dates readable at enlarged text
tasks.body:
Goal:
Keep Planning, Inbox and Statistics selected native civil dates readable with enlarged text.

Current behavior:
The active canonical-destination matrix exposes Planning clipping at 360 pixels and 200-percent text. Native selected-date ink fails despite a valid date value. The prior completed date task was scoped to Today. Planning and Statistics use auto-fit field grids, rem-based card/input padding and native date inputs; Statistics shares the same finite-width risk and requires qualification rather than an assumed failure.

Desired behavior:
Repair the affected field layout and padding so native date segments remain readable. Retain date edits, date bounds, source scope and journal behavior. Qualify all three reused routes in Chromium and WebKit.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Components/TodoPlanningPanel.razor`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Components/TodoStatisticsPanel.razor`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Workspace/TodoPlanningPanelTests.cs`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Workspace/TodoStatisticsPanelTests.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-planning-date-journey.mjs`

Implementation constraints:
Use a scoped layout repair, no global fixed date width or font/zoom reduction. Preserve native inputs, civil-day rules, limits and provider/account boundaries. No task acceptance, external provider, cloud restore, publication or consent change. Existing local synthetic build/test authorization applies. Physical devices, other locales and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
The original parent failure is the layout regression. Use current Release, exact isolated profiles, actual observed appearance, six widths, normal/200-percent text, light and dark schemes including `obsidian-glow`, selected-date pixel comparison, visible native focus and current-source cleanup receipts. Existing meaningful date/filter tests remain required.
